name: Cordis
source:
Abel, the owner of the museum, is a puppeteer and seems to be going to a tea party at the customer's house today.
The doll he left behind, Cordia, is ordered to clean the hall.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6292]official site[/url]]
translation:
博物馆馆主亚伯是一名木偶师，今天似乎要去顾客家参加茶会。他留下的玩偶科迪亚则被吩咐打扫大厅。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6292]官方网站[/url]]
